facts.fact: Le Courrier d'Algerie reports the director of the Oran university hospital (EHU 1er novembre 1954) said the hospital marks ten years since launching its electronic patient record.
The ministry of health's director of information systems said a 2024-2028 digitisation plan with 15 axes, including development of the electronic medical record, has been drawn up.

systems.country_label: Oran university hospital electronic patient record
